reader.self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5) subagent acting as a join-pass reader; read each item's observation and claim cards in full from join-queue.json, opened deposit texts with Read where context was needed, located other lines by grep; phrases copied by script.

sets.name: The Fixed Point of Destruction (#1412) and its composition risk
sets.basis: #1413's audit forecasts how the composition layer will absorb #1412's coinage, so the forecast and the thesis it concerns belong to one line while staying distinct claims.

evidence.phrase: the terminal position of a destructive process is occupied by the party who reports it
#1412's principal composition risk is not latency but absorption

sets.name: Apocalyptic Philosophy: Deleuze and Guattari (#605)
sets.basis: The priority record states #605's core thesis (D+G in the apocalyptic mode) and the Blake thesis supplies the lineage that thesis runs through; distinct claims of one paper's argument.

evidence.phrase: D+G operate in the apocalyptic mode
William Blake is the explicit link between the apocalyptic tradition and Deleuze and Guattari's method

sets.name: Socrates as orthonym and the heteronymic configuration
sets.basis: Each treats Socrates as the founding figure the corpus is built on: the vow of logos (#346), the orthonymic position whose gesture is willing death for logos and whose configuration documents itself (#123), and the fully constructed figure who first carries the dialectic (#1679).

evidence.phrase: a fully constructed figure. historical without history. like logos becoming flesh

sets.name: Radical energy translated into administration
sets.basis: One operation, the translation of radical energy into administrable form, applied to two agents: law (#239) and the cognitive labor aristocracy (#470).

evidence.phrase: law is historically where labor's radical potential gets translated into managed rights
the translation of radical energy into administrative flow

sets.name: Differential survival as transmission design
sets.basis: Both explain which ancient texts survive by properties of their transmission, and #1569 names the Sappho case as the precedent and model for its survival test; one template applied to lyric and to the Platonic-Aristotelian corpus.

evidence.phrase: Poems compete for survival based on their transmission effectiveness.
What distinguishes what survived from what was lost

sets.name: Diversity contraction boundary law and its test battery
sets.basis: #857 proposes a longitudinal measurement of whether model divergence is contracting and invokes the mediation ratchet, the mechanism whose link 3 #779.F2 leaves untested; distinct tests of one contraction line.

evidence.phrase: which is the scarcity-feedback the Ratchet requires

sets.name: Diversity contraction boundary law and its test battery
sets.basis: #1540.B2 is marked a model proposition over the Diversity Contraction mechanism, and #1427.G1 states the same recursive classifier narrowing at CERN; distinct institutional applications of one contraction line.

evidence.phrase: It is a recursive narrowing already underway
The loss will be experienced as improvement.

sets.name: Anticipatory erratum genre
sets.basis: Two anticipatory errata in the same form, each withdrawing a forthcoming work in advance and announcing it will appear anyway; one template applied to two works.

evidence.phrase: The work will nevertheless appear, since its publication was necessary to discover why.
The demonstration will nevertheless appear, since its publication was necessary to discover why it fails.

sets.name: Sappho 31 erratum chain
sets.basis: #1086 anchors its Sappho 31.5 reading in the fifth erratum (#1052) and #1475 accompanies the sixth erratum of the chain; distinct claims on the transmitted break of Sappho 31 within the erratum chain.

evidence.phrase: together specify the ground of the daring: not privilege but poverty
The difference between those verdicts is not evidence.

observations: TJ02.1: #1413 line 45 restates the #1412 absorption finding as a re-measurement target (T17's first epoch re-measures 'Josephus-mathematics dominance over deposit #1412's term-space'); it is a later restatement of PRED-1413.B1 not carried on the card. PRED-1413.B1 also already sits in the series 'The Josephus Thesis', although #1412's thesis is the internal witness condition, not NT authorship.

TJ02.2: PRED-3.H2 (the Slavonic interpolations composed as 'NOT LATE CHRISTIAN') and PRED-248.H2 (the Josephus Thesis chain, which holds #1226's statement) are already both in the series 'The Josephus Thesis'; nothing added. The bearing of PRED-3.H2 on a dating falsifier of #203/#1226 is a relation of evidence to falsifier, not a join; a reception pass may want it.

TJ02.4: The 'account' cluster has no join among its claims. PRED-343.H1 (ATLWM XXVIII, 'The Socratic Vow before encountering the Phaedo') is subject-adjacent to PRED-346.H1 (The Socratic Vow of Logos as Salvation, item TJ02.6); not joined here because the item sets may use only the item's claims.

TJ02.5 and TJ02.7: PRED-1211.B4, PRED-203.H4, PRED-832.H14 and PRED-1211.H16 are already all in the series 'Josephus thesis claim ladder'; nothing added. PRED-832.H14 ('The Greek admits both') and PRED-1211.H16 ('admits -- and arguably prefers') are two claims registered the same day in different documents; neither text shows one revising the other, so they stay distinct.

TJ02.6: Apparent contradiction, recorded and not reconciled: #123 holds that 'the historical Socrates remains historically real' (AXN-02A9 line 77), while PRED-1679.H1 gives the author's reading of Socrates as 'a fully constructed figure. historical without history'. Linked by series only.

TJ02.8: The registration dates now on the cards agree with the capture entries' own dates: PRED-3.F11 is registered 2026-10-12 and its entry (the-final-time-full-title-aio-20261012) is dated 2026-10-12; the '2026-10-04' in the source observation is the date of one of that entry's cards (johannes-sigil-final-time-aio-20261004). PRED-3.F3 is registered 2026-07-25, its entry's date. The file-date problem the observation names appears already corrected.

TJ02.9, TJ02.16, TJ02.18, TJ02.21: already linked by the triage (later statement, or shared series); nothing added. TJ02.16: the #1389 statement is now carried as a later statement of PRED-149.A2 dated 2026-06-04, so the 2026-03-22 date of deposit #1389 is not the registration date of the claim; the #1389 deposit date itself still appears wrong for a text describing a June 3-4, 2026 session.

TJ02.11: PRED-78.D1 cites EA-CS-ASSEMBLY-01 (#73) as the source of its planetary designations, but PRED-73.E3's statement is a 2087 lunar-routing row and says nothing about planetary designations. The relation is a deposit-level citation, not a relation between these two claims; left unlinked. A claim in #73 that states the designations, if one is registered, would be the partner of PRED-78.D1.
TJ02.12 and TJ02.17: apparent contradictions (PRED-499.B1 vs PRED-510.B1; PRED-209.G5 vs PRED-519.D3 and PRED-656.G1); recorded as observations by the source readers, no set.

TJ02.14 and TJ02.15: both sets extend the existing series 'Diversity contraction boundary law and its test battery' (which holds PRED-779.G1 and PRED-855.G1). #1540 declares itself 'Series: Diversity Contraction' and marks PRED-1540.B2 a model proposition 'over the §2.4 mechanism of Diversity Contraction'; its abstract cites EA-LO-WOLFBOY-01 (#855), whose law also says 'The loss is experienced as improvement.' Several other near-identical series names exist from earlier batches ('Diversity Contraction / Mediation Ratchet programme', 'Diversity contraction and tail-thinning programme', 'diversity contraction under machine mediation'); the assembler may want to treat them as one series.
TJ02.19: 'Anticipatory erratum genre' extends an existing series name; 'Anticipatory erratum sequence (#1598–#1601)' also exists.

TJ02.22: PRED-1086.H2 and PRED-1475.H2 extend the existing series 'Sappho 31 erratum chain'. PRED-1486.F8 (the Longinus figure census) belongs to the existing Philo blind-reconstruction series names ('Blind-reconstruction program, Sappho 31 in Philo' and others), not to the erratum chain; its card shows no series, so a later pass may add it there. #1086's Sappho passage sits in a CERN revocation Effective Act because §5 anchors the genre's cost-principle at Sappho 31.5; the title is not a mislabel.

TJ02.23: PRED-855.G1 and PRED-779.G1 are already in one series; #855 states a substrate-specific developmental law and does not present itself as a revision of #779's boundary law, so no states set. TJ02.24: no join among the claims; the non-chronological low deposit numbers are not flagged.
